reasoning: The icon shows a lightning bolt (flash/electricity) crossed out by a diagonal slash. While originally a camera UI icon for 'flash off', in a task planner it serves well for power outages, shutting off breakers, disconnecting electric utilities, or no-flash photography. It is distinct from a plain lightning bolt because the slash specifically cues absence or shutting off power.
